Mute the team

Not muted

For planned work. While the team is muted, MMHotline sends no Pushover notifications or automated voice calls. Other contact methods send only if “Send even when the team is muted” is on.

Only an administrator can mute the team.

Where the schedule is set

Set in /etc/mmhotline/mmhotline_settings.yml, in on_call_schedule. An administrator edits the settings file with sudoedit, then runs sudo mmhotline settings apply.
